# CMIT Solutions of the Meadowlands

> Claude Partner Network member and owner-operated MSP in Rutherford, NJ. AI implementation and business automation for small and mid-sized businesses (5–500 employees), built on a managed IT and cybersecurity foundation. CISSP-led. Serves Bergen, Hudson, Essex, Passaic and Morris counties, New Jersey.

## Facts
- Name: CMIT Solutions of the Meadowlands (franchise of CMIT Solutions, 250+ locations)
- Address: 301 NJ-17 N, Ste 800, Rutherford, NJ 07070, USA
- Phone: +1 (201) 777-4345

- Opened: September 2025 · Owner: Orest Sison, CISSP
- Partnership: Claude Partner Network (Anthropic) — resells and deploys Claude for Work
- Builds with (no partner status claimed): GoHighLevel, Vapi, Twilio, Microsoft 365 / Power Automate

## AI and automation services
- AI implementation for small business: Claude for Work and Microsoft Copilot rollout with data-access guardrails, DLP, acceptable-use policy, staff training
- Business automation: Power Automate, GoHighLevel (CRM, Twilio SMS, calendar sequences), Google Sheets + Claude API pipelines
- AI voice agents for inbound intake and outbound follow-up (Vapi + Twilio)
- LinkedIn and social content automation (RSS curation → narrative scoring → scheduled posts) for owners and professional firms
- Self-improving outbound email systems with rubric and adversarial-review loops
- Custom internal apps and agents deployed inside the client's environment (client-owned infrastructure, federated auth)

## Managed IT and cybersecurity foundation
- Managed IT and 24/7 help desk; Microsoft 365 security and migration (Entra ID, Intune, Defender, DLP)
- Cybersecurity compliance as a service: HIPAA, FTC Safeguards Rule (WISP), ALTA Best Practices; vCISO; NIST CSF risk assessments; managed detection and response; backup and disaster recovery

## Typical clients
CPA and tax firms, medical and dental practices, title agencies, law firms, financial services, nonprofits, logistics and professional services in North Jersey.

## Service area
Rutherford, Lyndhurst, East Rutherford, Carlstadt, Secaucus, North Arlington, Clifton, Nutley, Belleville, Passaic, Hoboken, Union City, North Bergen, Jersey City, Hackensack; Bergen, Hudson, Essex, Passaic and Morris counties, NJ.
